triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Released by the maintainer** (recorded on #34659 at 23:01Z, comment 6963538703: 「云端的任务你说暂缓，他也不会排的呀，是不是应该先放回队列」 and 「其他技能体系的卡如果改动面大不是理由啊…那就应该开放」). `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`. Theme: MCP, epic #34659 (in focus).

Router-sized SKILL.md, one skill per PR, each judged on the skills eval runner (#34764). The eval saw skills invoked with their reference never opened. Measured improvement, no named customer failure, so p2.

Worktree: `objectstack-issue-34770`
Domain: `domain:skills`
Seat: `repo:objectstack#3`
File surface (this part): `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` (router: first checks, at most ~8 run-time traps, routing list; budget 6–9 KB, hard cap 500 lines), `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/**` and `skills/objectstack-ui/references/**` (receive what moves out, or are pointed to), `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/**` (only if a case's expected answer moves home; layout-free tokens), `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (the moved files' rows, by the measured bytes), root `.changeset/`. ⛔ Not `skills/objectstack-ai/**` (ask-data text stays until #35038 lands).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent` (area o3-C os-dev), `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (dispatch-gates --tier printed "Model tier — MANDATORY" for `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` ⇢ 'skills/**', clause ①, no one-line exit), `effort: high` (seat 00:08Z: restructure)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: published skills `objectstack-ui`, then `objectstack-automation` and `objectstack-data`, in objectstack (each SKILL.md restates option lists and key tables the protocol already serves, 15.7 / 28.0 / 26.6 KB on main, so the few run-time traps hide in reference text the model skips: the eval saw a skill invoked with its reference never opened) | none | every authoring agent that installs the skills
Thread-read: 6963621367
Premise: holds on origin/main 367e324eeb. `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 15,704 bytes / 304 lines, `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 27,988 / 468, `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 26,646 / 473, all above the card's 6–9 KB budget. The runner #34764 is closed and on main (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/`).
Part-of plan: one skill per PR, each `Part-of #34770`, the last `Fixes #34770`. (1) ui now: no open PR touches `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, `rules/**` or `references/**`; #35022 (o3-J, draft) edits only `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/*` and the ui router does not need to touch its case files. (2) automation after #35002 (#34637) and #34839's PR land, both on `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`, a likely destination of moved text. (3) data after #35039 (#34785, `SKILL.md`), #35042 (#34742, `rules/relationships.md`) and #34964 (#34504, seat 4, `references/data-hooks.md`) land.
Serial constraints cleared: file-level census of every open PR's files against `skills/objectstack-{data,ui,automation}/**` (at claim time): ui collides with none outside `evals/`; collisions for parts 2 and 3 are listed above and gate their start. overlap-check before every push.
Pre-claim lane: `domain:skills` — seat-assigned to area o3-C.
Pre-claim deps: none named; released from `pm:on-hold` by the maintainer (6963538703 on #34659).
Prior rulings read: #34691 S3 = A (6943107981), #34659 6940528935 and 6963538703; skills line-budget ruling record 6513306068; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack
